dialog.equationOptions.title: Equation Options
dialog.equationOptions.note: U:quill/equation: how equation text is typed (Unicode math in the linear format, or LaTeX); the Equation tab's Tools launcher opens it. Word's box also lists Math AutoCorrect rules: not offered, not checked against upstream.

insert.illustrations.shapes.note: U:quill/shapes-gallery: all 180 preset shapes of the catalogue (core/prism/model/geom/preset, translated from deckcraft crates/geom) in Office's groups: Recently Used, Lines, Rectangles, Basic Shapes, Block Arrows, Equation Shapes, Flowchart, Stars and Banners, Callouts, each drawn from its own geometry; the shape is saved to .docx under its own preset name. wordcraft's gallery has a dozen. Action Buttons are PowerPoint's and are not offered.
